001
002package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node;
003
004import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IFeatureFlagContainerItem.FlagContainer;
005import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IFeatureModelContainerItem.ModelContainer;
006
007import java.util.function.Supplier;
008
009import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
010
011/**
012 * Generates child node items for Metapath node items.
013 * <p>
014 * Provides methods to create lazy suppliers that generate child node items for
015 * field, assembly, and module node items in both data model and metaschema
016 * model contexts.
017 */
018public interface INodeItemGenerator {
019
020  /**
021   * Generate the child Metapath node items for the provided item.
022   *
023   * @param item
024   *          the parent item to generate child node items for
025   * @return a container that consisting of the child node items
026   */
027  @NonNull
028  Supplier<FlagContainer> newDataModelSupplier(@NonNull IFieldNodeItem item);
029
030  /**
031   * Generate the child Metapath node items for the provided item.
032   *
033   * @param item
034   *          the parent item to generate child node items for
035   * @return a container that consisting of the child node items
036   */
037  @NonNull
038  Supplier<ModelContainer> newDataModelSupplier(@NonNull IAssemblyNodeItem item);
039
040  /**
041   * Generate the child Metapath node items for the provided item.
042   *
043   * @param item
044   *          the parent item to generate child node items for
045   * @return a container that consisting of the child node items
046   */
047  @NonNull
048  Supplier<ModelContainer> newDataModelSupplier(@NonNull IRootAssemblyNodeItem item);
049
050  /**
051   * Generate the child Metapath node items for the provided item.
052   * <p>
053   * The provided item is based on a Metaschema module and has no associated
054   * value. As a result, the child items will have no associated value.
055   *
056   * @param item
057   *          the parent item to generate child node items for
058   * @return a container that consisting of the child node items
059   */
060  @NonNull
061  Supplier<FlagContainer> newMetaschemaModelSupplier(@NonNull IFieldNodeItem item);
062
063  /**
064   * Generate the child Metapath node items for the provided item.
065   * <p>
066   * The provided item is based on a Metaschema module and has no associated
067   * value. As a result, the child items will have no associated value.
068   *
069   * @param item
070   *          the parent item to generate child node items for
071   * @return a container that consisting of the child node items
072   */
073  @NonNull
074  Supplier<ModelContainer> newMetaschemaModelSupplier(@NonNull IAssemblyNodeItem item);
075
076  /**
077   * Generate the child Metapath node items for the provided item.
078   * <p>
079   * The provided item is a Metaschema module and has no associated value. As a
080   * result, the child items will have no associated value.
081   *
082   * @param item
083   *          the parent item to generate child node items for
084   * @return a container that consisting of the child node items
085   */
086  @NonNull
087  Supplier<ModelContainer> newMetaschemaModelSupplier(@NonNull IModuleNodeItem item);
088}
